messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — saw routing flip for requests using a service-account token during a small quota surge. Traffic moved from dedicated pool -> hosted fallback and metrics attributed to org default, not the originating project. Anyone else see sticky routing break on SA tokens?

maria: yeah saw that in the dashboard earlier, the per-project telemetry dropped and org-level spiked. looks like the route_key used for attribution got overwritten when fallback happened. (adding screenshot link in #incidents)

chen: can you paste an example header dump? curious whether the original origin-project header was lost or masked by the proxy.

sam: paste from proxy logs: 
```
x-rd-origin: project:proj-42
x-rd-auth-method: service_account
x-rd-route: pool:dense-gpu-02
x-rd-fallback: true
x-rd-effective-route: pool:shared-hosted-1
```
we're seeing effective-route set after the fallback and the attribution pipeline reading `x-rd-origin` earlier in the hop stack, not after final routing.

olivia: console UX thing: we currently show "request route" and "origin" columns but not the final effective route. that's confusing for SREs troubleshooting. Suggest adding an "effective route" line in the request inspector and a small badge when fallback occurred.

raj: for quotas we treat SA tokens as first-class principals when the token has `project` claim. But if routing changes, billing attribution should still use the original claim. Sounds like a timing/order bug in telemetry collection.

maria: agreed. telemetry ingestion reads headers at ingress -> enqueues -> routing happens async -> fallback modifies route header. we need to either: 1) compute attribution at the final routing decision point, or 2) snapshot origin claims early and pass them down as immutable attributes (e.g., `x-rd-origin-asserted`).

chen: proposal (simple): add an opaque attribute `x-rd-attr-origin` at authn stage and read that for quota/billing. fallback can change `x-rd-route` but not `x-rd-attr-origin`. Example policy snippet: 
```
# auth middleware
if auth.method == "service_account":
  set_header("x-rd-attr-origin", auth.claims.project || auth.claims.org)
```

sam: I like attribute snapshot approach. Minimal surface area change. Also can we add a boolean `x-rd-fallback` and a route_reason tag to telemetry so dashboards can filter fallback noise?

olivia: console change: show `Effective route` + `Route reason` in inspector. For rollouts, add a toggle to display "Use asserted origin for billing" so finance can validate before defaulting it on.

raj: one more wrinkle: delegated tokens (cross-project SA impersonation). If token was minted by project A but impersonating project B, which project gets billed? Current policy says impersonated project, but orgs asked for visibility on the minting project. We should include both: `x-rd-attr-origin` and `x-rd-attr-imprinter` so we can attribute to one and show the other.

maria: agree. We'll also need to update rollup metrics naming: `tokens.requests_by_origin` and `tokens.requests_by_imprinter`. Add a tag `route_fallback=true/false`.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/attr-origin-header -> staging (canary 1%) :rocket:

sam: perfect. rollout plan suggestion: 1) deploy auth middleware to snapshot asserted origin + imprinter header 2) change telemetry to read asserted origin for billing (canary 1% traffic) 3) enable console inspector fields behind feature flag 4) expand canary to 10% and validate metrics 5) full rollout.

chen: add debug header for canary users: `X-RD-Debug-Route: true` so we can get full traces without sampling noise. Also add metric `route_mismatch_count` that increments when `x-rd-origin != billing_attribution`.

olivia: UX note: in console inspector show a single-line explanation when mismatch occurs: "Billing uses asserted origin (project:proj-42) despite final route pool:shared-hosted-1 — see route reason: capacity_fallback" and a link to the trace.

maria: I'll open a small PR to change ingestion to prefer `x-rd-attr-origin` if present. tagging @raj and @chen for review.

sam: thanks — can we try to keep the naming consistent: `x-rd-attr-origin`, `x-rd-attr-imprinter`, `x-rd-effective-route`, `x-rd-fallback` and `x-rd-route-reason`. saves us a future migration. :+1: 

raj: ack. will review PR today.

chen: noted. I'll wire route_mismatch_count in the routing service.

olivia: filing console ticket next, will add mockups. :mag: 

sam: awesome. if anyone sees other weird attribution spikes, ping here.
